title: Local reranker model
requirement: Provide one open-weight reranking model, or establish that none is needed, for the second stage of local retrieval over code, documents and session text.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Gain in top-5 retrieval quality over the first stage alone on a fixed query set, added latency per query and GPU memory beside the other local models.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
